1-2.word_for_word: गोपीनां कामतः कृष्णे निःसीम-प्रेम-सङ्गमः । — The gopīs, lustfully, fell in love with Kṛṣṇa without limit.; कात्यायन्य्-अर्चनोद्भूत- तत्-प्रसाद-महोदयः ॥ — The worship of the goddess Kātyāyanī is the source of all her grace.; द्वा-विंशे गोप-कन्यणां वस्त्राहरण-लीलया । — In the twenty-second century, the cowherd girls were playfully stripped of their clothes.; वरं दत्त्वा गतः कृष्णो यज्ञ-शालाम् इतीर्यते ॥ — After giving the boon, Lord Kṛṣṇa went to the sacrificial pavilion.; प्रथमे मासि मार्ग-शीर्षे ॥१-२॥ — In the first month, at the head of the march.
1-2.translation: The gopīs, lustfully, fell in love with Kṛṣṇa without limit. The worship of the goddess Kātyāyanī is the source of all her grace. In the twenty-second century, the cowherd girls were playfully stripped of their clothes. After giving the boon, Lord Kṛṣṇa went to the sacrificial pavilion. In the first month, at the head of the march.

4.word_for_word: महा-माये इत्य्-आदि-सम्बोधनैस् तव न किञ्चिद् अशक्यम् इति सूचयन्त्यः प्रत्य्-एकं प्रार्थयन्ते ॥४॥ — They pray to each other, indicating that nothing is impossible for You by addressing them as 'Maha-maya' and so on.
4.translation: They pray to each other, indicating that nothing is impossible for You by addressing them as 'Maha-maya' and so on.

5.word_for_word: कृष्ण-चेतस्त्वम् आह---भूयान् नन्द-सुतः पतिर् इत्य् आनर्चुर् इति ॥५॥ — You, the mind of Krishna, said, "May the son of Nanda be your husband, and they will worship you.
5.translation: You, the mind of Krishna, said, "May the son of Nanda be your husband, and they will worship you.

6-7.word_for_word: व्रतस्य पूर्वाङ्गम् आह---उषसीति । — The preliminary part of the vow is called Ushasi.; गोत्रैर् नामभिः । — by the names of the gotras.; अन्योन्याबद्ध-बाहवः परस्परं गृहीत-पाणयः ॥६॥ — They clasped their arms together and held each other's hands.
6-7.translation: The preliminary part of the vow is called Ushasi. by the names of the gotras. They clasped their arms together and held each other's hands.

8.word_for_word: योगेश्वराणाम् ईश्वर इति प्रत्येकं तादृङ्-मनोरथ-पूरण-सामर्थ्यं दर्शयति, तासां कर्मणः सिद्धये फल-दानायेति ॥८॥ — He is the Lord of the masters of yoga, and each of them shows His ability to fulfill such desires, and to bestow the fruits of their actions.
8.translation: He is the Lord of the masters of yoga, and each of them shows His ability to fulfill such desires, and to bestow the fruits of their actions.

9.word_for_word: नीपं कदम्बम् । — Neepa is a kadamba.; बालैः सह ॥९॥ — with the children.
9.translation: Neepa is a kadamba. with the children.

10.word_for_word: हे अबलाः ! — O weak ones!; नो नर्म न परिहासः यस्माद् यूयं व्रत-कर्शिताः व्रत-श्रान्ताः ॥१०॥ — We are not joking nor laughing because you are exhausted from your vows and tired of your vows.
10.translation: O weak ones! We are not joking nor laughing because you are exhausted from your vows and tired of your vows.

11.word_for_word: तत्रास्माकम् आग्रह इत्य् अर्थः ॥११॥ — There is our insistence, that is, the meaning.
11.translation: There is our insistence, that is, the meaning.

12.word_for_word: क्ष्वेलितं परिहासम् । — It’s a teasing joke.; प्रेम-परिप्लुताः प्रेम-रस-निमग्नाः ॥१२.१३॥ — They are overwhelmed with love and immersed in the taste of love.
12.translation: It’s a teasing joke. They are overwhelmed with love and immersed in the taste of love.

14.word_for_word: तत्र मुग्धा ऊचुः । — There they said, fascinated.; अङ्ग ! — Ang!; भोः श्री-कृष्ण अनयम् अन्याय्यं मा कृथाः ॥१४॥ — O Lord Krishna, do not do this injustice.
14.translation: There they said, fascinated. Ang! O Lord Krishna, do not do this injustice.

15.word_for_word: प्रौढा ऊचुः । — The adults said.; नो चेद् राज्ञे नन्दाय कंसाय वा ब्रुवाम । — If not, we will tell King Nanda or Kaṁsa.; ब्रुवाम हे कृष्णेति॥१५॥ — Let us say, O Krishna.
15.translation: The adults said. If not, we will tell King Nanda or Kaṁsa. Let us say, O Krishna.

16.word_for_word:
न व्याख्यातम्। — Not explained.; : थिस् लिने इस् नोत् फ़ोउन्द् इन् अल्ल् एदितिओन्स्, बुत् इस् दिस्चुस्सेद् इन् अल्ल्
थे गौदिय चोम्मेन्तरिएस्। — This line is not found in all editions, but is discussed in all
The Gaudian Chommentaries.
16.translation:
Not explained. This line is not found in all editions, but is discussed in all
The Gaudian Chommentaries.

17.word_for_word: प्रोत्तेरुः निर्गताः ॥१७॥ — They rose up and went out.
17.translation: They rose up and went out.

18.word_for_word: आहताः ईषद्-अक्षत-योनीर् वीक्ष्य ॥१८॥ — They were struck by the slightly intact vagina.
18.translation: They were struck by the slightly intact vagina.

19.word_for_word: धृत-व्रताः सत्यो विवस्त्रा अपो व्यगाहताप्सु स्नाता इति यत् तद् एतत् उ एव देव-हेलनम् अपराध एवेत्य् अर्थः । — The fact that they observed vows, were truthful, naked, and bathed in water immersed in water means that this u is the same as disrespecting the gods and is a crime.; व्रत-वैगुण्य-भीतानां प्रायश्चित्तम् इवाह---अस्यांहसः पापस्य निवृत्तये मूर्धन्य् अञ्जलिं बद्ध्वाधो नमः प्रणामं कृत्वेति ॥१९॥ — As atonement for those who are afraid of the vices of vows, he says, "For the remission of this sinful act, I should bow down with my palms folded on my head and offer my obeisances below.
19.translation: The fact that they observed vows, were truthful, naked, and bathed in water immersed in water means that this u is the same as disrespecting the gods and is a crime. As atonement for those who are afraid of the vices of vows, he says, "For the remission of this sinful act, I should bow down with my palms folded on my head and offer my obeisances below.

20.word_for_word: इति दोषत्वेनाच्युतेनाभिहितं विवस्त्राप्लवनं व्रतस्य च्युति-हेतुं मत्वा तस्य पूर्ति-कामास् तद्-अशेष-कर्मणां तस्य व्रतस्यण्येषाम् अशेष-कर्मणां च साक्षात्-कृतं फल-भूतं तम् एव नेमुः । — Considering that the nakedness of the Lord, which Lord Acyuta had told them about as a fault, was the cause of the fall of the vow, the desires of the Lord were fulfilled.; स एवावद्य-मृक् पाप-मार्जकः ॥२०॥ — He alone is the destroyer of faults and the wiper of sins.
20.translation: Considering that the nakedness of the Lord, which Lord Acyuta had told them about as a fault, was the cause of the fall of the vow, the desires of the Lord were fulfilled. He alone is the destroyer of faults and the wiper of sins.

22.word_for_word: दृढम् अत्यर्थं प्रलब्धा वञ्चिताः, यूयं विवस्त्राः [भा।पु। — Strongly deceived and deceived, you are naked [Bh.p.; १०.२२.१९] इत्य्-आदिना । — 10.22.19] etc.; त्रपया लज्जय हापितास् त्याजिताः, अत्रागत्य स्व-वासांसि [भा।पु। — They were abandoned by shame and shame, and came here to put on their clothes [Bh.p.; १०.२२.१६] इत्य् आग्रहेण । — 10.22.16] by insisting.; प्रस्तोभिता उपहसिताः, सत्यं ब्रवाणि नो नर्म [भा।पु। — They were provoked and laughed at, I tell you the truth, no joke [Bh.p.; १०.२२.१०] इत्य्-आदिना । — 10.22.10] etc.; क्रीडनवत् कारिताश् च, बद्धाञ्जलिं [भा।पु। — and made as if they were playing, with bound hands [Bh.p.; १०.२२.१९] इत्य्-आदि-प्रायश्चित्त-च्छलेन । — 10.22.19] by the trick of atonement.; ता नाभ्यसूयन् दोष-दृष्ट्या नापश्यन् ॥२२॥ — They did not envy them nor did they see them as faults.
22.translation: Strongly deceived and deceived, you are naked [Bh.p. 10.22.19] etc. They were abandoned by shame and shame, and came here to put on their clothes [Bh.p. 10.22.16] by insisting. They were provoked and laughed at, I tell you the truth, no joke [Bh.p. 10.22.10] etc. and made as if they were playing, with bound hands [Bh.p. 10.22.19] by the trick of atonement. They did not envy them nor did they see them as faults.

23.word_for_word: प्रेष्ठ-सङ्गमेन सज्जिता वशी-कृता अतो गृहीत-चित्ताः सत्यो नो चेलुः । — Armed with the company of their beloved, they were subdued, and therefore their minds were captured, and they did not move truly.; गृहीत-चित्तत्वम् आह---तस्मिन् कृष्णे लज्जायितेक्षणाः, लज्जा-विलसितम् ईक्षणं यासां ता इत्य् अर्थः ॥२३॥ — He argues that the mind is caught up in that darkness, meaning those whose eyes are shy, whose gaze is bright with shame.
23.translation: Armed with the company of their beloved, they were subdued, and therefore their minds were captured, and they did not move truly. He argues that the mind is caught up in that darkness, meaning those whose eyes are shy, whose gaze is bright with shame.

24.word_for_word: दामोदर इति भक्त-वात्सल्यं दर्शयति, अबलाः प्रति ॥२४॥ — Damodara shows affection for the devotees, towards the weak.
24.translation: Damodara shows affection for the devotees, towards the weak.

25.word_for_word: भोः साध्व्यः ! — Bhoh sadhvyah!; भवतीनां मद्-अर्चनं सङ्कल्पो मनोरथः स च लज्जया युष्माभिर् अकथितोऽपि मया विदितः । — I know your resolve to worship Me and your desire to do so, even though you have not told me about it out of shame.; स मयानुमोदितश् चातः सत्यो भवितुम् अर्हति । — That is what I have approved of and therefore it must be true; अर्हतीति सम्भावना-मात्रोक्त्या आत्यन्तिको न भविष्यतीति सूचितम् ॥२५॥ — By merely saying that he deserves it is indicated that he will not be the ultimate.
25.translation: Bhoh sadhvyah! I know your resolve to worship Me and your desire to do so, even though you have not told me about it out of shame. That is what I have approved of and therefore it must be true By merely saying that he deserves it is indicated that he will not be the ultimate.

26.word_for_word: तत् कुतः ? — Where is that from?; इत्य् अत आह---न मयीति । — It is therefore argued that it is not in me.; कामाय पुनः काम-भोगाय । — For desire, again, for the enjoyment of desire.; विषय-महिम्ना कामस्यापि शान्ति-हेतुत्वाद् इति भावः । — This means that even desire is the cause of peace by the glory of objects.; कामाप्ररोहे दृष्टान्तः । — An illustration in the sprouting of lust.; भर्जिता दग्धा क्वथिता पक्वा धाना यवादि । — They are roasted, burnt, boiled, cooked grain, barley, etc.; बीजाय अङ्कुरोद्गमाय । — For the seed to sprout.; प्राय इति स्वेच्छया पुनः प्ररोहम् अपि सूचयति, ध्रुवादीनां तथा दर्शनात् ॥२६॥ — Almost also indicates voluntary re-sprouting, since the Dhruvas and others see it as such.
26.translation: Where is that from? It is therefore argued that it is not in me. For desire, again, for the enjoyment of desire. This means that even desire is the cause of peace by the glory of objects. An illustration in the sprouting of lust. They are roasted, burnt, boiled, cooked grain, barley, etc. For the seed to sprout. Almost also indicates voluntary re-sprouting, since the Dhruvas and others see it as such.

27.word_for_word: सिद्धाः पूर्ण-मनोरथाः । — They have fulfilled their desires.; तद् आह---इमा आगमिनी रात्रीर् मया रंस्यथेति । — He said, “You will enjoy me this coming night.”; आर्या कात्यायिनी । — Arya Katyayani.; सतीः सत्यः ॥२७॥ — Sati is the truth.
27.translation: They have fulfilled their desires. He said, “You will enjoy me this coming night.” Arya Katyayani. Sati is the truth.

28.word_for_word: भक्त्यानुकम्प्य कन्यास् तास् तद्-विवर्जित-यज्वनाम् । — The daughters, moved by devotion, were moved by the sacrifice, which was devoid of it.; पत्न्य्-अनुग्रहतस् तेषाम् अहन् कर्म-महामदम् ॥२८॥ — By the grace of his wife he killed their great pride in action.
28.translation: The daughters, moved by devotion, were moved by the sacrifice, which was devoid of it. By the grace of his wife he killed their great pride in action.

29.word_for_word: अथ तासां गमनानन्तरम् । — Then, after they had left.; श्रीतोषिण्यां तु गोप-कन्यासु प्रसादम् उक्त्वा तत्-प्रस्ताव-सादृश्याद्य् अज्ञपत्नीषु प्रसादं वक्तुम् आरभते । — After expressing his grace to the daughters of the cowherd men, who are satisfied with the goddess of fortune, the Lord begins to express His grace to the ignorant wives of the Lord, who are similar to His proposal.; अथ लीलान्तरारम्भे । — Then, at the beginning of the play.; स च निदाघ-समय एवेति ज्ञेयम् निदाघार्कातपः इति वक्ष्यमाणत्वात् । — It is to be understood that it is the time of summer heat, since it is said that summer heat is the sun’s heat.; अत एव सहाग्रजः श्री-बलदेव-सहितः । — That is why he is with his elder brother Sri Baldev.; वस्त्राहरण-दिने तत्-साहित्याभावात् । — On the day of the stripping, there was no literature on it.; गोपैः परिवृत इति प्राग् उक्तिर् वक्ष्यमाण-लीलायां तेषाम् अपेक्षा-विशेषात् । — The previous statement that he was surrounded by the cowherd men is because of the special expectation of them in the pastime being described.; देस्वकीसुत इति । — He is the son of Deswaki.; पूर्वस्माद् एव हेतोः वृन्दावनाद्-गतो दूरम् इति प्रथमं तावदिग्रिव्रजमयं काम्यकवनं गतः तत एवास्य धातुर् आगमयवेशो वर्णयिष्यते, पश्चान् निदाघ-तृष्णागमितधेनु-जल-पायनार्थं व्रजं दक्षिणे विधाय यमुनाम् आगतः । — For the same reason that he had gone far from Vrindavan, he first went to the Kamyaka forest, which was full of mountains and Vrajas.; तच् च व्रजाद् आगच्छन्-मध्याह्नं भोज्य-वञ्चनार्थम्, तच् च श्री-यज्ञ-पत्नीष्व् अन्न-प्रार्थना-रूप-कृपार्थम् इति ज्ञेयम् ॥२९॥ — It is to be understood that the midday meal coming from Vraja was for the purpose of cheating food, and that it was for the purpose of showing mercy in the form of prayer for food to the wives of the sacrifice of the goddess of fortune.
29.translation: Then, after they had left. After expressing his grace to the daughters of the cowherd men, who are satisfied with the goddess of fortune, the Lord begins to express His grace to the ignorant wives of the Lord, who are similar to His proposal. Then, at the beginning of the play. It is to be understood that it is the time of summer heat, since it is said that summer heat is the sun’s heat. That is why he is with his elder brother Sri Baldev. On the day of the stripping, there was no literature on it. The previous statement that he was surrounded by the cowherd men is because of the special expectation of them in the pastime being described. He is the son of Deswaki. For the same reason that he had gone far from Vrindavan, he first went to the Kamyaka forest, which was full of mountains and Vrajas. It is to be understood that the midday meal coming from Vraja was for the purpose of cheating food, and that it was for the purpose of showing mercy in the form of prayer for food to the wives of the sacrifice of the goddess of fortune.

30.word_for_word: निदाघ उष्णोपगमः इत्य् अमरान् निदाघो ग्रीष्म-र्तुः, तत्-स्वीकारे हेमन्ते प्रथमे मासि [भा।पु। — Nidagha is the approach of heat, and the immortals Nidagha is the summer season, in the first month of winter in its acceptance [Bh.p.; १०.२२.१] इत्य् उपक्रमो विरुध्येतातो\ऽत्र निदाघ-पदेन स्वेदाम्बु ज्ञेयम् । — 10.22.1] This is contrary to the approach, so the term summer here means sweat water.; निदाघ ऋतु-भेदे स्याद् उष्ण-स्वेदाम्बुनोर् अपि इति मेदिनी । — Summer is the difference between the seasons, and even hot, sweaty water is the same as the earth.; निदाघः स्वेदाम्बु तत्-करोऽर्को निदाघार्कः । — The summer sun is the sweat-water, and the sun is the sun of the summer sun.; मध्यपदलोपी समासः । — A compound with a middle clause.; तस्यातापो निदाघ-तपस् तस्मिन् तीव्रे मध्याह्ने सति । — The heat of the summer was intense at noon.; द्रुमान्वीक्ष्येत्य् अन्वयस् ततो न विरोध इति । — The consequence is that he should look at the trees, and therefore there is no contradiction.; आनपत्रम् इवाचरन्तीत्य् आपत्रायन्ते, आतपत्रायितास्तान् । — They are afraid that they are acting like other leaves, and they are afraid of them.; आचारार्थक्यङ्तात्कर्तरिक्तः । — Apart from the subject of the action-meaning kyng.; व्रजौकस इति द्रुम-विशेषणम् । — Vrajaukas is a tree-adjective.; आत्मन इत्य् उपलक्षणं स्वस्य स्वेषां च ॥३०॥ — This is the sub-characteristic of the self and of their own.
30.translation: Nidagha is the approach of heat, and the immortals Nidagha is the summer season, in the first month of winter in its acceptance [Bh.p. 10.22.1] This is contrary to the approach, so the term summer here means sweat water. Summer is the difference between the seasons, and even hot, sweaty water is the same as the earth. The summer sun is the sweat-water, and the sun is the sun of the summer sun. A compound with a middle clause. The heat of the summer was intense at noon. The consequence is that he should look at the trees, and therefore there is no contradiction. They are afraid that they are acting like other leaves, and they are afraid of them. Apart from the subject of the action-meaning kyng. Vrajaukas is a tree-adjective. This is the sub-characteristic of the self and of their own.

31.word_for_word: सम्बुद्ध्य्-आत्मक-पद्यम्---हे स्तोकोऽल्पः कृष्णः कृष्ण-वर्णो यस्येति तथा सर्वेषां सम्बोधनानाम् अग्रिमेण पश्यतेति क्रिया-पदेन सम्बन्धः । — The self-conscious verse: O Stoke, whose little black complexion is dark, and whose complexion is related to the verb, looks forward to all addresses.; गोप-गणना-क्रमो\ऽयं यथा-दृष्टि-प्राप्तम् एव ज्ञेयः । — This order of counting the cows should be understood as seen.; एते दश श्री-कृष्णस्य दश-दिक्षु रक्षणार्थं प्रेम्णा वर्तन्त इति केचित् सम्भावयन्ति दश-सङ्ख्याकत्वात् । — Some believe that these ten are lovingly protecting Lord Kṛṣṇa in the ten directions, since they are numbered ten.; तत्र स्तोक-कृष्णादयोऽष्टाव् अष्ट-दिक्षु देवप्रस्थ-वरूथौ छत्र-धारण-वर्त्म-शोधनादिनोर्ध्वाधो-देशयोर् ज्ञेयो एकादशो भद्रसेनस् तु गोपसेनाध्यक्षः । — There are eight demigods named Stoka, Kṛṣṇa and others, who are known as Devaprastha and Varutha in eight directions.; रामश् च सर्वापेक्षकस् तदानीं दूरे स्थित इति लभ्यते ॥३१॥ — It is found that Rama who is indifferent to all is now standing at a distance
31.translation: The self-conscious verse: O Stoke, whose little black complexion is dark, and whose complexion is related to the verb, looks forward to all addresses. This order of counting the cows should be understood as seen. Some believe that these ten are lovingly protecting Lord Kṛṣṇa in the ten directions, since they are numbered ten. There are eight demigods named Stoka, Kṛṣṇa and others, who are known as Devaprastha and Varutha in eight directions. It is found that Rama who is indifferent to all is now standing at a distance

32.word_for_word: विप्र-भार्यानुग्रहाय यज्ञ-वाटं गच्छन् विप्राणां काठिन्यम् अभिप्रेत्य तेभ्योऽपि द्रुमाः श्रेष्ठा इति तान् अभिनन्दति चतुर्भिः, पश्यतेति । — When he goes to the sacrificial path to show mercy to the wives of the brāhmaṇas, he notices the difficulty of the brāhmaṇas and greets them with four words, saying that the trees are better than them.; हे स्तोक-कृष्णा दयो गोपाः, एतान् द्रुमान् पश्यत् । — O cowherd men of Stoke and Krishna, look at these trees.; परार्थम् एवैकान्तेन जीवितं येषां तान् । — Those who live alone for the sake of others; तद् आह---वात-वर्षादीन् स्वयं सहन्तः सहमाना अस्माकं वारयन्ति ॥३२॥ — That is why he said, "They themselves endure wind and rain and other things, and they prevent us from being endured.
32.translation: When he goes to the sacrificial path to show mercy to the wives of the brāhmaṇas, he notices the difficulty of the brāhmaṇas and greets them with four words, saying that the trees are better than them. O cowherd men of Stoke and Krishna, look at these trees. Those who live alone for the sake of others That is why he said, "They themselves endure wind and rain and other things, and they prevent us from being endured.

33.word_for_word: सुजनस्य कृपालोर् अर्थिन इव ॥३३॥ — as if seeking the mercy of a good man.
33.translation: as if seeking the mercy of a good man.

34.word_for_word: निर्यासो घन-रसः । — Excretion is a thick juice.; तोक्माः पल्लवाद्य्-अङ्कुराः ॥३४॥ — Tokmas are the leaves and other sprouts.
34.translation: Excretion is a thick juice. Tokmas are the leaves and other sprouts.

36.word_for_word: इत्य् अभिनन्दन् प्रवालादि-समूहैर् नत-शाखानां तरूणां मध्येन यमुनां प्राप्तः ॥३६॥ — Having thus greeted him he reached the Yamuna amidst the trees with bowed branches and clusters of corals and other trees
36.translation: Having thus greeted him he reached the Yamuna amidst the trees with bowed branches and clusters of corals and other trees

38.word_for_word: कुमारिकाभ्यः पूर्वम् एव तन् नर्माकुलतया अगृहीत-भोज्यानाम् एव निर्गमात् क्षुधार्ता इत्य् उक्तम् ॥३८॥ — It was said that the maidens were already hungry because they had already gone out of the food they had not taken because of their jokes.
38.translation: It was said that the maidens were already hungry because they had already gone out of the food they had not taken because of their jokes.
